title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Rahm Exits LIV Golf
items.text: Jon Rahm's decision to leave LIV Golf creates a major dilemma for PGA Tour CEO Brian Rolapp as golf's biggest stars face uncertainty ahead of 2027.

items.headline: McIlroy's Career News
items.text: Rory McIlroy announced new career plans less than two weeks after TMRW Sports renewed its deal with ESPN.

items.headline: Spieth Ready for Return
items.text: Jordan Spieth says his body is finally ready for competition after years of wrist surgery, marking a key stage in his comeback.
